query: SELECT input.position AS "position!", prm.source_provider_model_id AS "provider_model_id?" FROM unnest($1::uuid[], $2::text[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS input(provider_id, upstream_model, position) LEFT JOIN providers p ON p.id = input.provider_id AND p.state <> 'disabled'::provider_state LEFT JOIN provider_revision_models prm ON prm.provider_revision_id = p.active_revision_id AND prm.upstream_model = input.upstream_model AND prm.enabled ORDER BY input.position
